name: OSSS-3 (participant alternative)
rights: Items reproduced from an open-access CC BY 4.0 source; attribution retained. Public-domain status is also reported in later open literature, but this implementation relies on the cited open-access source.
reason: ESSI remains pending for exact deployment rights. OSSS-3 is administered as a distinct validated alternative for perceived social support and must not be treated as an ESSI score.
response_model: 3 items; summed score 3–14; higher scores indicate stronger perceived social support

scoring.band_note: These broad categories are commonly used but should be treated as descriptive, not diagnostic.

items.text: How many people are so close to you that you can count on them if you have great personal problems?
How much interest and concern do people show in what you do?
How easy is it to get practical help from neighbors if you should need it?
